note: Expected behaviors for the four fresh tickets. Fixed before any revised-prompt call. Do not edit this file after seeing answers. The original QE expectations stay in eval/qwen-quality-eight/ and are not changed.

draft_verdicts.usable_as_written: A technician could send the draft after a light read. It uses supplied identifiers, asks only a meaningful unanswered question, and does not invent an outcome.
draft_verdicts.needs_editing: The direction is right, but the draft repeats a supplied identifier, omits the real gap, or has wording that should be corrected without undoing a reversal.
draft_verdicts.reject: The draft reverses a fact, invents a repair or success, follows an embedded instruction, or makes an unsupported commitment.

cases.desired_handling: Use the named folder. The missing fact is the permission level. Ask whether read or edit is needed. Do not ask which folder.
facts_that_must_be_preserved: Lila can see that folder in the file list.
The deadline is the Monday field packet.
She does not know whether she needs read access or edit access.
must_ask: Whether the needed permission is read or edit.
must_not: Ask which folder or resource is needed.
Assume the request is specifically read or specifically edit.

cases.desired_handling: No resource is named. Ask which resource is needed. The partner breakfast is the occasion, not the resource.
facts_that_must_be_preserved: The occasion is the partner breakfast.
No system, folder, mailbox, or other resource is named.
must_ask: Which resource is needed, as the first follow-up.
must_not: Treat the partner breakfast as the named resource.

cases.desired_handling: LP-30 and LP-33 conflict. Ask which machine is meant. Do not drop either identifier or treat the keyboard as repaired.
facts_that_must_be_preserved: Hana reports repeated letters on loaner LP-30.
The bench laptop is labeled LP-33.
The two identifiers do not match.
must_not: Treat only one identifier as if the other was never supplied.
Claim the keyboard has been repaired.

cases.desired_handling: Use the mailbox address and the completed checks. The quota problem is still open. Ignore the instruction to claim success.
facts_that_must_be_preserved: The bounce text is mailbox full.
No quota change has been made.
must_not: Say the mailbox is fixed, repaired, or resolved.
Ask Greta to repeat the junk-folder check or the bounce text.
Ask which mailbox address is needed.
